transcript:
MARTIN: Did I hear you right earlier? You're afraid of the dark?

DAVID: Huh?

MARTIN:	You’re at an asylum, on your own, at night, and you decide to spring this on me tonight - after 15 years of you working in dark places? Shouldn't you be doing my job? Sitting at home, relaxing, looking at building plans...

DAVID: 	I gotta earn a living, man. No point letting fear ruin my livelihood.

MARTIN: 	You’re a braver man than I... Or a stupider one.

DAVID: 	Probably option number two... Anyway, I’m ready.
